messages:
josh: Quick update on the GPTQ bakeoff across Llama/Mistral/Qwen — ran 4-bit/3-bit variants overnight. Core ask: can we triage regressions and pick deployment candidates? Links with CSV below.

priya: Upload summary: overall perplexity uplift small for Llama-GPTQ-4 but got 4.2% EM drop on TriviaQA. Full CSV: https://s3.redwood-internal/bakeoffs/gptq_crossfam_176987.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:

carl: Noted similar on Mistral-4q. Instruction-following A/B test shows drop in helpfulness. Snippet from eval run:
```
model,mix,EM_exact,helpful_score
mistral-gptq-4,base,0.82,0.71
mistral-gptq-4,fp16,0.86,0.78
```

mina: Could be KV cache alignment; GPTQ kernels sometimes reorder matmul ops. I can re-run with stable-kv flag and compare. Plan: (1) rerun Mistral with stable-kv, (2) run AWQ baseline, (3) schedule a canary in eu-west1-dedicated.

eval-bot: Automatedeval completed: delta_summary: Llama-GPTQ-4: +0.7 ppl, Qwen-GPTQ-3: +1.1 ppl, Mistral-GPTQ-4: +2.9 ppl; hallucination rate up 0.8% on instr tasks.

josh: Good. For deployment candidates, priya — which profiles look stable for Dedicated? Looking for <1.5% EM regression and latency <120ms p50.

priya: Candidate profiles:
- llama-7b-gptq-4: quant_profile v2-cpuopt, latency 95ms p50, EM reg +0.9%
- qwen-7b-gptq-3: quant_profile v1-hetero, latency 110ms p50, EM reg +1.2%

carl: Mistral needs more attention; hold on prod. I'll open a short PR to disable Mistral-4q in routing table until we have stable kv.

mina: I'll start the stable-kv run now. ETA ~45m. If it helps, we can also try per-layer scale correction (awq-ish) after.

josh: Thanks — ping here when stable-kv finishes. If stable, we'll do a canary with traffic split 1% for 24h.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: job_id=cnb-176987-1, region=eu-west1-dedicated, traffic=1% once image ready.

priya: adding a short note to the bakeoff doc with links and per-metric thresholds. Also tagging @platform for routing tweaks.

marta: cc @security — no data plane changes expected, but FYI for audit trail.

josh: solid. Appreciated. :thumbsup:
